import pandas as pd

df = pd.DataFrame({
    "user_id": ["123", "456", "789"],
    "score": [1.5, 2.7, 3.9]
})

# Convert to narwhals
df = nw.from_native(df)

# Convert columns: user_id string->Int32, score float64->Float32
df = df.with_columns(
    user_id=nw.col("user_id").cast(nw.Int32),

)

# Convert back to native
result = nw.to_native(df)
print(result)
print(result.dtypes)
